strings.text: Build with your agent, or deploy a sample app yourself.
strings.original: Build with your agent, or deploy a sample app yourself.

strings.text: Copy this prompt into your coding agent
strings.original: Copy this prompt into your coding agent

strings.text:
Build [describe your app] using CARLOS principles and Rastrillo.

Read https://github.com/carlosframework/skills/blob/main/skills/getting-started/SKILL.md and https://rastrillo.org/SKILL.md first.

I want to deploy to carloku.com. Help me connect my account, then build, test and deploy the app. Use the current installation commands in rastrillo.org/SKILL.md.
strings.original:
Build [describe your app] using CARLOS principles and Rastrillo.

Read https://github.com/carlosframework/skills/blob/main/skills/getting-started/SKILL.md and https://rastrillo.org/SKILL.md first.

I want to deploy to carloku.com. Help me connect my account, then build, test and deploy the app. Use the current installation commands in rastrillo.org/SKILL.md.

strings.text: You need Git, Go 1.26 or later, and the CARLOS command-line tool.
strings.original: You need Git, Go 1.26 or later, and the CARLOS command-line tool.

strings.text:
git clone --depth 1 https://amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo
cd rastrillo/examples/notes
go test ./...
GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o notes-linux-arm64 ./cmd/notes
strings.original:
git clone --depth 1 https://amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo
cd rastrillo/examples/notes
go test ./...
GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o notes-linux-arm64 ./cmd/notes

strings.text:
carlos auth login --console https://console.carloku.com
carlos auth whoami
carlos apps create --app notes
strings.original:
carlos auth login --console https://console.carloku.com
carlos auth whoami
carlos apps create --app notes

strings.text: Approve the sign-in code in your browser. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID below with the account short ID printed by whoami.
strings.original: Approve the sign-in code in your browser. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID below with the account short ID printed by whoami.

strings.text:
carlos instances enable --app notes
carlos instances create --app notes --host notes.YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID.oncarlos.com --channel edge
carlos env set --app notes NOTES_ORIGIN=https://notes.YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID.oncarlos.com
carlos deploy --app notes ./notes-linux-arm64
strings.original:

carlos instances create --app notes --host notes.YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID.oncarlos.com --channel edge
carlos env set --app notes NOTES_ORIGIN=https://notes.YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID.oncarlos.com
carlos deploy --app notes ./notes-linux-arm64
